candidates.change_summary: Change the supportsInterface to always return false (so it no longer reports support for IAccessControl).
Change the supportsInterface to report support only for IERC165 (i.e., ignore IAccessControl even if super supports it).
Change the supportsInterface to report support for IAccessControl only (omit IERC165), returning true iff interfaceId == type(IAccessControl).interfaceId.
Invert the original condition so it returns false when interfaceId == IAccessControl and otherwise defers to super.
Change hasRole to always return the opposite of the stored membership (negate result).
Change hasRole to always return true (ignore stored membership).
Change hasRole to always return false (ignore stored membership).
Change hasRole to return membership for the zero address instead of the supplied account (always checks address(0)).
Change hasRole to check membership under DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE regardless of the provided role (ignores role parameter).
